_comment: TMs and HMs. Each machine teaches one move to a compatible creature (compatibility = the creature's `teachable` list, or a type-matched default). kind 'tm' is consumed on use (one teach per copy owned); kind 'hm' is reusable (never consumed, can be taught to any number of creatures). Order here is display order. Editable indirectly: which creatures can learn a machine's move is set per-creature in the Creature Editor.

TM10.name: TM10 Venom Jab
TM10.desc: Teaches Venom Jab (may poison). Single use.

TM11.name: TM11 Toxic Spray
TM11.desc: Teaches Toxic Spray (badly poisons). Single use.

TM12.name: TM12 Frost Breath
TM12.desc: Teaches Frost Breath (may freeze). Single use.

TM14.name: TM14 Guard Stance
TM14.desc: Teaches Guard Stance (blocks the turn, but not twice running). Single use.

TM15.name: TM15 Quick Spin
TM15.desc: Teaches Quick Spin (hits, and sweeps hazards off your side). Single use.

TM16.name: TM16 Hyper Bite
TM16.desc: Teaches Hyper Bite (may make the foe flinch). Single use.

TM17.name: TM17 Triple Beam
TM17.desc: Teaches Triple Beam (may paralyze). Single use.

HM01.name: HM01 Headbutt
HM01.desc: Teaches Headbutt. Reusable — teach to as many creatures as you like.
